english: Check the month and share of the bed
draft: Kontroleer die maand en die deel van die bedding

english: Independent practice: follow the sample design into its crop plan, identify one bed’s area and open one planting. Explain its status, month and area share. Change one planned month, save and reopen it, then restore it with Undo.
draft: Onafhanklike oefening: volg die voorbeeldontwerp na sy gewasplan, identifiseer een bedding se oppervlakte en maak een aanplanting oop. Verduidelik sy status, maand en oppervlaktedeel. Verander een beplande maand, stoor en maak dit weer oop, en herstel dit dan met Ontdoen.

key: Check the agreed quantity and total
english: Check the agreed quantity and total
draft: Kontroleer die ooreengekome hoeveelheid en totaal

english: Check the buyer and every line. Keep kilograms, bags, bunches and other units as they were agreed. The app does not know a bag’s weight unless you have measured and recorded it.

key: The saved document is the one you intended, and any pending update is visible.
english: The saved document is the one you intended, and any pending update is visible.
draft: Die gestoorde dokument is die een wat jy bedoel het, en enige hangende bywerking is sigbaar.

english: The saved details agree with the source; you have not treated an AI suggestion as proof.

key: Keep gaps visible

key: Inspect the output before sharing
english: Inspect the output before sharing

english: For real records, check what your bookkeeper or adviser needs and choose the recipient yourself. Review the attachments and private details before sending. Saving or downloading does not send the file to them.

english: Independent practice: in the sample tour, compare the CSV period with View summary. Open an exported copy, trace one figure to its source, and name one item the file does not contain. Stop before sharing.

english: The learner distinguishes needs from proposed objects, includes the people doing the work, and leaves missing resources visible. A list of attractive features alone does not pass this task.

Begin a design presentation with the brief. Show the existing situation and the evidence that mattered most. Then explain the chosen arrangement, an alternative you considered, the important trade-off and the first feasible phase. Keep unknowns visible; explaining a limitation is better than hiding it behind a confident picture.

Choose a format the learner can use: drawings, a printed map, spoken explanation, supported notes or the app. Assess the reasoning and relevant evidence rather than fluency with a device. Ask for consent before recording or sharing a person's presentation.

draft:
Begin 'n ontwerpaanbieding met die opdrag. Wys die bestaande situasie en die bewyse wat die meeste saak gemaak het. Verduidelik dan die gekose rangskikking, 'n alternatief wat jy oorweeg het, die belangrike afweging en die eerste uitvoerbare fase. Hou onbekendes sigbaar; om 'n beperking te verduidelik, is beter as om dit agter 'n selfversekerde prent te verberg.

Kies 'n formaat wat die leerder kan gebruik: tekeninge, 'n gedrukte kaart, mondelinge verduideliking, ondersteunde notas of die app. Assesseer die redenasie en tersaaklike bewyse eerder as vaardigheid met 'n toestel. Vra toestemming voordat jy 'n persoon se aanbieding opneem of deel.

Nooi spesifieke terugvoer uit. 'n Beoordelaar kan 'n ondersteunde sterkpunt, 'n ontbrekende aanname en 'n vraag wat die plan kan verander, noem. Luister voordat jy die tekening verdedig. Teken aan of die vraag ontbrekende bewyse, 'n misverstand in die aanbieding of 'n werklike botsing in die ontwerp blootlê.

english: Link each priority to an observation, a source or method, the person responsible and an agreed review point. State what the observation can and cannot demonstrate. Use practice data only if clearly labelled as supplied classroom data.

english: Build a small evidence folder or envelope, with references that match the notebook. Use sample records if private material cannot be redacted. Keep actual customer details out of classroom screenshots.

english: Give the evidence for your preference, the trade-offs, the unknowns and what could change the choice. A provisional preference is not permission to build.

english: List unresolved water, soil, access, technical or permission questions. Explain downstream effects and the evidence or advice needed before the affected work can proceed.
